data.title: Insmed: Price Target Raised to $175 on Sanofi Acquisition, Rating Downgraded to Hold
data.description:
Jefferies analyst Faisal Khurshid downgraded the rating on Insmed to a Hold today, setting a price target of $175.00.

Faisal Khurshid’s rating is based on Sanofi’s agreed acquisition of Insmed at $175 per share, which effectively establishes the stock’s near-term value. He therefore raised the price target to the transaction price while reducing the recommendation to Hold, since the shares offer little appreciation beyond the announced consideration. He also sees no meaningful obstacles to closing during the first half of 2027.
Khursid views a competing bid as unlikely because Insmed is limited in soliciting alternatives and would owe Sanofi a substantial termination fee if it changed course. Although Sanofi sees significant potential in Brinsupri, Arikayce, and TPIP, its valuation reflects adjustments for development, competitive, regulatory, and market risks. Those uncertainties, including TPIP’s remaining indication risk and future competition affecting Brinsupri, support a neutral stance rather than a more bullish call.

In another report released yesterday, Wells Fargo also downgraded the stock to a Hold with a $175.00 price target.
